name: Weekly invoice and cash chaser
why: Runs the weekly chase: who to chase, a reminder for each late payer and a 30, 60 and 90 day cash view, matching the overdue invoice chase skill.

name: Get a late invoice paid and keep the customer
why: A full run for one late invoice: a warm reminder, a range the customer can meet and a firm follow-up.

name: Payment reminder letter writer
why: Writes one reminder letter from the invoice facts and the customer history, for the steps on the tone ladder.

name: Invoice maker
why: Builds a single invoice with totals checked, once the invoice template is set up.

name: Check supplier invoices before approval
why: Matches supplier invoices into a register and lists amounts to investigate, the same job as the supplier invoice check skill.

name: Code vendor bills, flag odd ones and find supplier savings
why: Codes a batch of bills, flags odd ones and finds the biggest supplier savings, useful before a payment run.

name: Recurring invoice exception review assistant
why: Reviews recurring invoices for new exceptions each cycle, for subscriptions and retainers billed on a schedule.

name: Supplier terms and float planner
why: Works out the cash float from supplier terms and which terms to ask for, feeding the payment run plan.

name: Monthly contract renewal keeper
why: Catches supplier contract renewals, notice dates and price rises before the bills arrive.

name: Prepare a seasonal cash buffer
why: Builds a dated cash forecast with a downside case, for businesses whose receipts swing by season.

name: Disagreement calming line writer
why: Prepares calm replies for a payment call where the customer is likely to dispute or push back.
